description: An open coding agent for your terminal, built by a community collective rather than a company. Bring your own model, keep your code on your machine, and owe nothing to anyone.
vibe: Deep invariant verification, strict typing, and defensive boundary guarantees.
highlights: Instructions for AI coding agents working on **@nanocollective/nanocoder**. `CLAUDE.md` has the full architecture map; this file is the short version.

Nanocoder is a local-first CLI coding agent written in TypeScript. The terminal UI is React 19 rendered with Ink. It talks to many LLM providers (Ollama, OpenRouter, Anthropic, Gemini and any OpenAI-compatible API) through the Vercel AI SDK. It is not a web application.
assessment: Standard operational configuration for agentic pair programming.
